dictations.preRound: Weight 61.2 kg, down from 63.0 kg two weeks ago. Eating about 25 percent of meals. He takes metformin. HR 104 after therapy this morning, 88 at rest. Speech therapy saw him, thin liquids are fine. Discuss hospice with the family at the care conference Friday.
dictations.encounter: Quiet, answers questions, says he is not hungry. Add a nutrition supplement twice a day and weekly weights. His daughter wants to talk about goals of care.

note:
Interval Changes Since Last Visit

Weight 61.2 kg today, down from 63.0 kg two weeks ago. Oral intake remains poor at approximately 25% of meals. Resting heart rate 88 beats per minute; heart rate rises to 104 beats per minute after therapy. Speech therapy has cleared thin liquids. Resident remains quiet and oriented, denies hunger.

Current Vitals and Weight Trend

Heart rate 88 beats per minute at rest, 104 beats per minute after therapy. Weight 61.2 kg (down 1.8 kg from 63.0 kg two weeks ago). Vital signs otherwise not dictated today.

Functional Status Update

Not dictated.

Active Medical Problems

Deconditioning after pneumonia: Resident remains deconditioned with elevated heart rate response to therapy and progressive weight loss. Poor oral intake at 25% of meals contributes to ongoing weight decline. Thin liquids tolerated per speech therapy evaluation. Goals of care discussion requested by daughter; hospice discussion planned at care conference Friday.

Medication Changes

Metformin — active, dose not specified in dictation. Nutrition supplement added twice daily.

Assessment and Plan

Deconditioning after pneumonia with poor oral intake and progressive weight loss. Resident is quiet and interactive but reports no hunger. Heart rate elevation with activity is consistent with deconditioning. Weight loss of 1.8 kg over two weeks reflects inadequate caloric intake. Goals of care and possible hospice transition are being discussed with family.

1. Continue metformin as prescribed.
2. Add nutrition supplement twice daily to support caloric intake.
3. Obtain weekly weights to monitor nutritional status and deconditioning trend.
4. Continue thin-liquid diet per speech therapy clearance.
5. Facilitate goals-of-care discussion with daughter and family at care conference Friday, including hospice discussion as appropriate.
